q_telehealth_share.user_query: How much of my schedule is telehealth?
q_telehealth_share.ai_message: 54 percent of visits run as telehealth right now. That share is doing the access work for the long-drive half of the panel: the visit-mode suggestion offers telehealth whenever the reason is eligible, the drive is over an hour, and the patient has device access — and the 24-hour reminder repeats the offer with a one-tap switch. Patients in broadband dead zones are the exception; they stay in-person or use a clinic-hosted telehealth room, which is why the share plateaus rather than climbing forever.
